_readme: WP7 probes: cards changed by a WP7 override that have no worked-examples file (db/fixtures/card_worked_examples). snapshot_examples.js snapshots them too, and both harnesses run these probes exactly like worked examples (C6 shape; must pass; no known-failure list).
Probes are not issuer-verified worked examples: each cites the CardPipeline record text it checks. A probe card is never listed in verified_cards.json.

sources.quote: No BluChips are awarded on transactions converted to EMI.

examples.title: Rs 10,000 electronics purchase on EMI
examples.why: Record: "No BluChips are awarded on transactions converted to EMI." The record's emi_exclusion is already a rail-EMI exclusion on all spend (C8 D29a), so an EMI purchase in any category earns nothing.

examples.title: Rs 5,000 government payment (MCC 9399)
examples.why: Record: "Government services with MCC 9000-9999 earn 0.5 BluChips per Rs100" (the WP7 government_reduced override): 50 x 0.5 = 25, not the base 3.

examples.title: Rs 5,000 other retail spend
examples.why: Record base: 3 BluChips per Rs100 on other spends: 50 x 3 = 150.
